description:
Cast View from Above by paying {1}{U}, targeting Storm-Kiln Artist.
Storm-Kiln Artist and Veyran trigger twice.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Veyran triggers, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve View from Above, giving Storm-Kiln Artist flying until end of turn and returning View from Above to your hand.
Activate the two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
